title: One system from purchase order to collection
description: Vincare Pharma runs the distribution business end to end: procurement and supplier canvassing, warehouse and branch stock, institutional and retail sales, deliveries, collections and a general ledger that every financial report is produced from.
subtitle: Sourcing, stock, delivery and settlement handled in a single record, so nothing is reconciled twice or lost between departments.

backgroundImage.alt: Abstract healthcare supply chain background with geometric patterns

features.title: Sourcing and procurement
features.description: Shortfalls raise a costing request to purchasing, suppliers are canvassed on price and batch expiry, and the winning quote becomes a purchase order without re-keying.

features.title: Stock with batch and expiry
features.description: Warehouse and branch stock are tracked per batch and expiry date, so what is dispensed can always be traced back to what was received.

features.title: Ledger-backed reporting
features.description: Income statement, balance sheet and trial balance are computed from posted journal entries, not assembled from operational tables.
